name: Property Owners Task Force Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
y  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison I

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  2nd Floor Room 280A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Thursday, June 18, 2026
  4:30 PM

  Please be advised that pre-entry metal detector screening requirements are
  now in place in City Hall. Members of the public are requested to plan visits
  accordingly.

  In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, members of the public
  can view this meeting through live webcast at www.beverlyhills.org/live and on
  BH Channel 10 or Channel 35 on Spectrum Cable, and can participate in the
  teleconference/video conference by using the link above. Written comments may
  be emailed to mayorandcitycouncil(äbeverlyhills.org and will also be taken during
  the meeting when the topic is being reviewed by the Beverly Hills City Council
  Liaison / Small Business Assistance Task Force Committee. Beverly Hills Liaison
  meetings will be in-person at City Hall

  AGENDA

  1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to
  directly address the Committee on any item listed on the
  agenda.

  2) Welcome and Introductions

  3) Major Projects and Current Planning Update
   4) Update on California Senate Bill 79 and Beverly Hills Plan

  5) Information Sharing & Discussion with a Focus on Southeast
  a. Property Owners Updates
  1. Wilshire and La Cienega Area
  2. More Generally
  b. Current Commercial Retail Leasing Activity
  c. Tenants Coming-in; Tenants Leaving
  d. Available Spaces (Current and future spaces)

  6) Future Agenda Items Discussion

  7) Adjournment
